evals.prompt: I'm kicking off a new Foundry app called Ledger. Spin it up from our base so I've got the whole design system + Storybook ready to build on — no design zip yet, I just want the scaffold.
evals.expected_output: A new ledger-workspace seeded from foundry-base: renamed root package, bun install clean, typecheck + index:check + build-storybook green, canon + docbook reference intact, report of how to run Storybook. No components ported (no design provided).

evals.prompt: Here's the design export for our new pricing tool. Bootstrap a Foundry project from it and only build what's NOT already in @foundry/ui — reuse our existing buttons, cards, inputs etc.
evals.expected_output: Seeds base, runs analyze_zip + plan_ports, presents a reuse/port/pages plan that reuses canon primitives (Button/Card/Input/Icon) and only ports the genuinely new pricing components into apps/pricing/, builds pricing pages, regenerates the index, verifies green.

evals.prompt: Add a data-table component to this Foundry app — a sortable table with a header row and selectable rows.
evals.expected_output: Runs /foundry-component-check against foundry.index.json first: reports whether an existing component/composition covers it (e.g. TreeRow/Card + existing primitives), and only if genuinely new adds it under apps/<app>/ (or canon/ if reusable), reusing canon atoms, then regenerates the index.
